subject.title: Containerized/self-hosted deploys can't use externalized channel plugins: openKeyedStore is gated to trusted plugins, with no supported way to trust a self-hosted channel

question: Should OpenClaw add a provenance-preserving immutable/container install root for official external channel plugins, and which install sources may satisfy trustedOfficialInstall when the runtime state directory is mounted?
rationale: The source failure is clear, but the fix decides which external plugin code receives trusted host-managed state and channel ingress capabilities, so automation should not choose the permanent trust boundary.

options.title: Design Immutable Official Install Root
options.body: Add a supported build-time/install-time official plugin package and provenance root that survives a mounted runtime state directory while keeping raw load paths untrusted.

options.title: Document Same-State Snapshot Only
options.body: Keep the current trust model and document that container images must ship and mount the same OpenClaw state directory containing the install record.

options.title: Broaden Operator Trust Allowlist
options.body: Allow explicit operator config to trust load-path plugins, accepting a larger spoofing and provenance risk.

recommendation.title: Design Immutable Official Install Root
recommendation.body: Add a supported build-time/install-time official plugin package and provenance root that survives a mounted runtime state directory while keeping raw load paths untrusted.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to the live issue and already framed the trust-model tradeoff in the discussion.
